title: Operation Paperclip scientists in the childhood neighbourhood

tellings.quote: Operation Paperclip people apparently lived in my neighborhood.

plain: Whitley Strieber, a writer known for describing his own encounters with beings, says that when he was a boy in the 1950s in Terrell Hills, a neighbourhood of San Antonio, Texas, people from Operation Paperclip apparently lived nearby. Operation Paperclip was the US programme that brought German scientists to America after the Second World War, and if true, it would place his childhood right next to secret government science.
